timeline.title: Clone & Inspect
timeline.detail: Pull the repository and review docker-compose plus language containers to understand service boundaries.

timeline.title: Bootstrap Front-End
timeline.detail: Bun + Next.js App Router delivers the static microsite with Tailwind, NextUI, and Framer Motion.

timeline.title: Containerize Demos
timeline.detail: Each language ships as an isolated service exposing JSON output on ports 7001-7003.

timeline.title: Proxy Outputs
timeline.detail: API route /api/demo?lang= fetches container responses for local development and documentation.

timeline.title: Export & Deploy
timeline.detail: Run bunx next build && bunx next export and publish the static bundle to Vercel or CloudFront via CI/CD.
